title: Static Members, Extension Methods and Namespaces
summary: Static fields, properties, methods and constructors, static classes, constants and readonly fields, extension methods that add methods to existing types, namespaces and using directives, file-scoped namespaces, global usings, and organising a project into files.

cards.q: Why can a static method not use this?
cards.a: It belongs to the class, not to an object, so there is no instance for this to refer to.

cards.q: What makes a method an extension method?
cards.a: It is static, in a static class, and its first parameter is marked with this.
